posts.author: Jeffrey Weil
posts.content_md:
Lol, Hans is unhappy for the same reason we all were. It was COLD! One morning I had to scrape the ice from the inside of the windshield.

We were going to Brandsmart which was behind me as I took the picture. We needed a video cable.

posts.author: Dinesh
posts.content_md:
> **Jeffrey Weil:** Lol, Hans is unhappy for the same reason we all were. It was COLD!

But, Hans comes from Sweden! Besides the other two are smiling. Hans is probably thinking, "They think it's cold? Hah! They should come to Sweden in mid-winter!"

Actually, in 15 years, I don't think I've ever seen Hans smile. But then, in 30 years, I've never seen Fred smile either. Perhaps it's something in the lasers that makes all ancient holographers all-too-serious. I think I've managed to avoid this affliction because every time I look in a mirror, I burst out laughing!
